title: detection-engineering-ml alert, schema version 1.0
description: One alert per line of alerts.jsonl. Every key is always present; a missing value is null. The consumer (Skipa776/selfserviceagent) vendors a pinned copy of this file.

alert_id.description: sha256 hex of detector.id, '|', and the comma-joined event refs. The same detection always gets the same id.

id.description: Sigma rule id, or the anomaly model's name.

name.description: Sigma rule title, or the anomaly model's display name.

version.description: Sigma rule modified (else creation) date, or the anomaly model's version.

author.description: The Sigma rule's author field, verbatim. Kept because the Detection Rule License 1.1 requires messages based on rule matches to identify the rule's author. Null for anomaly detectors.

time_observed.description: When Windows wrote the event record, in UTC (docs/DECISIONS.md D18). Not the collector's receive time.

time_emitted.description: When this alert was written, in UTC.

process.description: Full path of the acting process image.

techniques.description: ATT&CK technique IDs the detector is tagged with. May be empty.

score.description: Anomaly score in [0, 1] for anomaly alerts; null for Sigma alerts.

event_refs.description: '<dataset id>:<line number>' of each event the alert is based on.

fields.description: Copied event fields: Channel, EventID, Image, CommandLine, ParentImage and the fields the rule tested, when present. Data only; command lines are never executed.

correlation_key.description: A grouping hint: '<host>|<first technique>' ('none' when untagged).

ground_truth.description: For evaluation only. Consumers must ignore it when deciding anything.
